svg.title: DreamCarve phase 4 mock-up: targets
svg.text: 15 · Targets (67): left, the Panel pocket selected, targets marked in tree and Viewport; right, target editing, clicking shapes to add or remove.
Click a shape (or a tree row) to add or remove it; marquee adds, Alt-marquee removes.
Tree rows show checkboxes; nothing else can be selected or moved.
Enter is Done (one undo step: Set targets of “Panel pocket”), Escape is Cancel.
The highlight follows each click. Non-targets fade to 40 %.
The Setup row says how many and which, with a warning glyph when a target
carries one. Pencil enters target editing; ⋯ holds Use selection / Add selection.
The tree's context menu has Add to “Panel pocket” / Remove from “Panel pocket”.
